title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Tennessee judge issues injunction blocking state move against Kalshi
summary: US Federal Judge Aleta Trauger granted Kalshi a preliminary injunction against Tennessee, finding its sports event contracts fall under CFTC jurisdiction.

title: Stablecoin A7A5 grows parallel system for sanctioned companies
summary: Stablecoin ecosystem A7A5 has faced accusations of sanctions evasion and, according to some analysts, is creating an alternative, sanctions-free financial network.

title: House Democrats press Treasury on World Liberty bank charter and UAE stake
summary: House Democrats are pressing Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent over World Liberty Financial’s push for a national trust bank charter, citing systemic risk.

title: Tether USDT supply set for biggest monthly decline since 2022 FTX collapse
summary: Tether’s USDT is nearing its largest monthly supply drop since the collapse of FTX, with whales and smart money traders continuing to reduce their USDT holdings.

title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $166M as BTC heads for worst start in years
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs are approaching a five-week outflow streak, with $2.7 billion in net redemptions year-to-date, as BTC posts one of its weakest starts to a year.

title: Metaplanet CEO rejects claims it hid details of Bitcoin trades
summary: Metaplanet’s Simon Gerovich addressed critics who accused the company of hiding losses and key details of its Bitcoin bets, as investor anger over leveraged Bitcoin treasuries spreads.

title: South Korean authorities under fire over $43B Bithumb Bitcoin error
summary: Lawmakers criticize South Korea’s Financial Services Commission after Bithumb mistakenly credited 620,000 BTC and the probe faces delays.

title: Parsec shuts down amid ongoing crypto market volatility
summary: The on-chain analytics firm‘s focus on decentralized finance and non-fungible tokens had fallen out of step with the industry‘s current trajectory.

title: White House floats limited stablecoin rewards in third crypto, bank meeting
summary: White House crypto adviser Patrick Witt reportedly refocused crypto and bank lobby talks on a crypto bill to allow stablecoin rewards tied to transaction activity.
